body.name: \(J_{xa}(z)\)
body.def: For \(z\in\{T^{\mathrm{ci}}_{n,m},eT^{\mathrm{ci}}_{n,m}\}\), set \(J_{xa}(z)=[0,1]\cap 2m\operatorname{CP}_{\gamma_0/(4m)}\{K_{xa}(z);n\}\) when this intersection is nonempty, and set \(J_{xa}(z)=\{0\}\) otherwise.
body.role: bias-free survival confidence input with singleton off-coverage totalization
